records.title: Manufacturing of Train Coaches
details: a to d: Establishment of new manufacturing unit at Kazipet has also been taken up at a coast of Rs. 521.36 Crs wherein manufacture of Mainline Electric Multiple Units (MEMU) rakes has been planned.

records.title: Skill Centres of Excellence
details: It is envisaged that five centres of excellence will be created throughout the country. These are to be housed and are natural skill training institutions.

records.title: Skill Centres of Excellence
details: We are currently looking at revamping the guidelines which requires a lot of consultation with industry and with sector skill councils so that these centres of excellence as denoted by the new framework can really derive best in the class performance, look at curriculum development and look at on-boarding industry in a meaningful manner.

records.title: Training of Emergency medical Technicians.
details: c to d:) Regulations for recognition of Allied and Healthcare institutions are under process in the Commission.

records.title: SETTING UP OF ESI HOSPITAL IN ONGOLE CONSTITUENCY
details: a to c: State Government of Andhra Pradesh has submitted a proposal to Employees' State Insurances Corporation (ESIC) for setting up of 30 bedded ESI hospital at Ongole in Andhra Pradesh.

records.title: Inadequate Medical Infrastructure
details: As far as NMC issue is concerned, there have been certain questions and queries about it. I am reviewing it, and I will see to it. We are having a dialogue with them.
